boards.tieRule: Offline main events in the top two tiers, so the Globals and the World Cup but also DreamHack, Gamers8 and the Esports World Cup. Level ones go to more podiums at those events, then to the bigger career earner.

boards.title: Top 10 by top-5 finishes at FNCS finals
boards.tieRule: Fifth or better at an FNCS grand final, counting every season and region. Level ones go to more top-3 finishes, then to more wins, then to the bigger career earner.

boards.title: Top 10 by FNCS grand finals without ever winning one
boards.tieRule: Grand finals reached by players whose FNCS title count is still zero. One win and you leave this board for good. Level ones go to more podiums in those finals, then to the better average finish in them, then to the bigger career earner.

boards.title: Top 10 earners who have never won an FNCS
boards.tieRule: Career prize money, among players with no FNCS title. Straight prize-money order.

boards.title: Top 10 by consecutive FNCS grand finals qualified for
boards.tieRule: The longest run of FNCS grand finals in a row, counting every region's own final as one round. Miss a round and the run starts again. Level ones go to the better average FNCS finish, then to the bigger career earner.

boards.title: Top 10 by consecutive FNCS titles
boards.tieRule: Winning your region's grand final in consecutive rounds of the FNCS. A Globals or a LAN in between is not an FNCS round, so losing one does not end the run - the consecutive major titles board counts those. Level ones go to more FNCS titles in all, then to more FNCS podiums, then to the bigger career earner.

boards.title: Top 10 by FNCS titles across different chapters
